enrichment_method: and then pre-washed GFP-Trap_A agarose beads (ChromoTek) was added to pull down target protein complex.
fractionation_method: After running samples on SDS-PAGE gel, the gel for the same lane was cut into five slices.
instrument: LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer
Protein samples were digested into peptides by trypsin and then analyzed on LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: After mass spectrometry, raw files corresponding to five slices from the same lane were merged and analyzed via MaxQuant (v1.6.0.16) using label free quantification (LFQ).
mass_analyzer: Protein samples were digested into peptides by trypsin and then analyzed on LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
ptm: The methyltransferase complex (m6A writer), which catalyzes the deposition of N6-methyladenosine (m6A) in mRNAs, is highly conserved across most eukaryotic organisms, but its components and interactions between them are still far from fully understood.
